description: Register a webhook to receive push notifications for signal events: new_follows, convergence, and on plans with the discovery lanes, people (the day's new stealth founders) and accelerators (the day's new cohort companies), delivered once a day when the lanes publish. Deliveries are signed with your secret if provided. Setup and each delivery draw on your monthly usage.

events.description: Event types to subscribe to. people / accelerators need the lane on your plan (403 lanes_not_enabled otherwise)

entity_types.description: Only deliver events for these entity types (e.g. "company", "fund")

lanes.description: people only: which lanes to deliver

min_convergence.description: Convergence only: minimum tracked accounts following. Default: 2

only.description: new_follows only: "people" = every individual your tracked accounts followed that day; "all" = raw diff; default "companies". people/all deliver once a day (~6 PM ET)

sectors.description: Only deliver events for targets in these sectors

tracked_accounts.description: Only deliver events from these tracked accounts

tracked_only.description: people / accelerators: only rows one of your tracked accounts follows

secret.description: Secret used to HMAC-sign delivery payloads

url.description: HTTPS endpoint to receive event payloads

name: frontrun_create_webhook
